top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The school age building still had a broken electrical outlet in the library center.

top_violation_types.title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - No Foods That Present Choking Risk (26 TAC §746.3317(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During an investigation it was found that a caregiver gave a toddler Mike and Ike candy which can be a choking hazard for that age group. The caregiver no longer works at the operation.

top_violation_types.title: Reduction of child/caregiver naptime ratio by 50% allowed, If 13 or more children in care, children are 18 mo. or older and other standards met (26 TAC §746.1613(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One classroom had reduced ratios for nap time that included a combination of infants and toddlers with 18 children to one caregiver. They are over ratio with nap time reductions not able to be used for this group.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children under 2 years old was observed watching television during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Crackers were served on a bare table for children to eat from.
